headline_findings: The successful regional four-expert construction is an admissible path-dependent policy with stored initial-state context and subaccounts, not a Markov feedback map on the original (t,u,x) state.

Finite-node class equality makes the neural/direct Adam gap primarily a question of the uncharacterized implicit preconditioner induced by the 355-to-48 neural map; explicit direct preconditioned baselines are missing.
Direct L-BFGS-B remains more accurate and materially cheaper than neural-Adam on all three held-out ensembles.
The full-state current-state bound remains about 7.24146 versus the unchanged 0.01 target, and no separate full-state actor payoff improvement is established.
The proposal optimizer uses a finite quadrature surrogate distinct from the continuous certified payoff, without a gradient-error or quadrature-refinement robustness study.
All 72 primary R23 proposals are accepted, so the acceptance operator is operationally inactive in the main R23 result.
